description_full: Nomad Foods Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and distributes a range of frozen food products in the United Kingdom and internationally. The company offers frozen fish products, including fish fingers, coated fish, and natural fish; ready-to-cook vegetable products, such as peas and spinach; and frozen poultry and meat products, comprising nuggets, grills, and burgers. It also provides meal products that contain ready-to-cook noodles, pasta, lasagna, pancakes, and other ready-made meals; ice creams, such as in-home and out-of-home ice creams; and other products comprising soups, pizzas, bakery goods, and meat substitutes. The company sells its products to supermarkets and food retail chains primarily under the Birds Eye, Green Cuisine, iglo, Findus, Aunt Bessie's, Goodfella's, Frikom, Ledo, La Cocinera, and Belviva brand names. Nomad Foods Limited was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Woking, the United Kingdom.

financial_summary: Nomad Foods Limited is a small-cap consumer defensive business with a $1.6B market cap on $3.4B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +3% over the past three years, which puts it in mature, slow-growth territory.
Returns on capital run at 7% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 30%.

The business throws off $281M in free cash flow — roughly 8 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 2.42× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 5.2× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 1.7× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 19.5% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 19% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
